# Hi — I’m **Akbar**

A third-year PhD student at the [Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IITGN)](https://iitgn.ac.in), India, working on **Computer Vision**, **Deep Generative Models**, and **Hyperspectral Imaging** in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering.

Before IITGN, I completed my B.Tech & M.Tech at [Aliah University](https://aliah.ac.in) and worked as a Project Associate at [IIT Ropar](https://iitrpr.ac.in).

> I enjoy tackling hard problems, building reproducible research code, and publishing robust models. I’m driven by curiosity and care about clean, well-documented work.
